technical-summary: The radiance build triggers (PR changes job and push paths) no longer exclude engines/radiance/archs.toml and layouts.toml: bc-serve embeds both and moe-remote reads archs.toml (declared build inputs in engine.toml since #763), so a layouts-only change must run the radiance build. Path-gate test updated.
user-summary-candidate: A change to the radiance layout or architecture tables now runs the radiance build in CI.
